subject: homeroom-newsletter-content
purpose: Canonical approved content source for the rolling Homeroom family newsletter (Track 2 / Fall). Future theme/layout changes may consume these sections; the theme must not invent or modify these sections without a new approval.
sourceAuthorityRule: These sections are now approved content sources. Future Homeroom theme/layout changes may consume these sections. The theme must not invent or modify these sections without a new approval.

behaviorTracker.title: Behavior Tracker
behaviorTracker.body: Beginning Monday, October 12, we are adding a new behavior tracker to the back of each student's stamp sheet. This system is designed to keep communication clear between school and home while helping students recognize patterns, make smart choices, and grow.
behaviorTracker.leadIn: After one verbal reminder, continued behaviors such as talking out, not tapping and tracking, or distracting others may result in a warning tally.
rules: Tallies reset every week, giving students a fresh start each Monday.
5 tallies in one week: the student will not visit the prize box that Friday, and a Grow Note will come home.
More than 5 tallies: an additional consequence may be needed, such as a 5-minute recess sit-out.
If patterns continue into future weeks, we may reach out to schedule a parent meeting so we can work together.
behaviorTracker.note: More serious choices, including lying, cheating, physical contact, or disrespect, may result in a Grow Note immediately.

waterBottlesAndDrinks.title: Water Bottles & Drinks
body: Please send water bottles only for use throughout the school day.

To help keep our classroom quieter, we ask that students avoid straw cups when possible. Silicone sleeves on metal bottles or plastic bottles are appreciated to help reduce noise, but they are not required.
Juice boxes and cans should be finished during snack or lunch.

scienceAndHistoryNotes.title: Science & History Notes
body: Students will take daily notes in a class packet as we work through each Science and History unit.
The completed packet will come home approximately two days before each test and will include the key concepts and vocabulary students should review.
These notes are designed to help students prepare using the same information we practiced together in class.

holidayPlans.title: Holiday Plans
body: Plans for upcoming holiday lunches, performances, and possible family invitations are still being finalized.
We will share dates and details with families as soon as plans are confirmed.

classMotto.title: Class 4A: Level Up Together.
classMotto.motto: Think sharp. Choose well. Work hard. Have each other's back.
classMotto.description: In Class 4A, success is not just about what one person can do. We get better when we challenge ourselves, make smart choices, encourage our teammates, and help the people around us succeed too. We are one class, one team, and we level up together.

dates.event: Book Character Day OR Spirit Shirt with uniform bottoms

bookCharacterDay.title: Book Character Day
bookCharacterDay.intro: On Friday, October 30, our school is celebrating Book Character Day! Participation is optional. Students who choose not to participate will follow the approved school attire option for that day: Spirit Shirt with uniform bottoms.
participating: Students who participate may dress as their favorite character from a children's fiction book.
Students must bring the book to school.
Students should be prepared to talk about their book and character.
characterRestrictions: Costumes and outfits may NOT represent celebrities, political figures, or pop-culture figures.
Costumes and outfits may NOT represent ghosts, monsters, witches, or wizards.
Costumes and outfits may NOT represent characters from TV shows, movies, or video games.
prohibitedItems: Masks, weapons, and Halloween costumes are not permitted.

movieNight.title: Family Movie Night
movieNight.body: Save the date for Family Movie Night on Thursday, November 6, from 6:00 to 8:00 PM. We hope to see your family there!

progressReportsAndReportCards.title: Progress Reports & Report Cards
body: Progress Reports go home on November 6, and Report Cards go home on December 22.
These are great checkpoints for students to celebrate their growth and set a goal for what comes next.

afterSchoolClubs.title: After-School Clubs
afterSchoolClubs.body: Quarter 2 after-school clubs are starting soon! Visit the After-School Clubs link in Family Quick Links below to view current offerings and sign-up details.

carpool.title: Carpool Reminders
rules: Students should enter and exit from the passenger side only.
Parents should remain inside their vehicles.
Do not change lanes while in the carpool line.
The afternoon carpool tag should be clearly visible from the rearview mirror.
Please avoid cell phone use during carpool.
K–5 families should not enter campus for afternoon pickup before 2:00 PM.
K–5 afternoon families normally follow the purple arrows.
Staff may direct vehicles to the blue route when needed while preserving arrival order.

contactGuidance.title: Questions? Start with Mr. Reagan
body: For questions about your child's academics, behavior, assignments, or classroom experience, please reach out to Mr. Reagan first. I am usually the person who can give you the quickest and most accurate answer.
For school-wide needs such as tuition, technology, or front-office questions, families can use the school's official contact channels.
